verdict.rationale: Helicone's own docs have a dedicated self-host section. It offers multiple deployment methods, including Docker Compose, for running your own instance, and the vendor describes the product as open-source. The Commons Clause comment questions the open-source label, not whether self-hosting works, so it creates no dispute. Missing for 10: details of deployment methods beyond Docker Compose, evidence of feature parity between self-hosted and cloud, and independent hands-on reports of a self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Deploy your own instance of Helicone using your preferred method.
Helicone offers multiple deployment methods to suit your infrastructure and scalability needs.
Docker Compose: Ideal for quick setups, local development, or small-scale deployments without complex infrastructure requirements.
